about_the_game:
🎮 Game Overview

Expeditions is an auto-battler game where heroes explore a [Continent Field] made of hexagonal tiles and branch into various [Exploration Zones].
They gather resources, rebuild destroyed village structures, and upgrade buildings to equip stronger heroes with better gear and skillbooks.
As enemies grow tougher and more complex, players must strengthen their expedition teams to acquire increasingly rare items.

📖 Story

Not long ago, the world was devastated by “the Event”—when abyssal creatures burst forth from the ground and destroyed every human settlement.
You barely survived, living as a refugee in a shattered world.
One day, a letter arrives: “Return to the village.”
Now, as the [Guide], you lead other survivors back to your ruined homeland.
Your mission: rebuild the village, restore stability to the region, and prepare to face the abyss once more—while helping the other races who sacrificed themselves to stop the catastrophe.

🛡️ Heroes

Heroes will arrive at your village, and their traits and potential will be easy to assess.
At first, only humans will join, but as you complete quests for other races, they too will become powerful allies in your Expeditions.
As heroes level up, their stats grow stronger—but if you provide the right environment that matches their class traits, they can unleash power far beyond their base stats.

⚔️ Equipment & Skillbooks

Equipping heroes with gear and skillbooks tailored to their class unlocks their true potential.
Equipment can be enhanced by consuming duplicates, and skillbooks can be socketed with special runes.
If you discover the rune effects you want to add, your heroes will automatically cast skills with those effects embedded.

short_description: Lead an expedition of self-fighting heroes to gather resources and rebuild a village destroyed by the Abyss. Equip them with gear and skillbooks to unlock their full potential. Explore the continent, help other races, and guide humanity—before the Abyss returns.
supported_languages: Korean, English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Italian, Traditional Chinese
